img_size is passed at build time, not inferred at the first forward: the window partition is baked into the module graph, and a mismatch surfaces as a tensor-size error deep in attention rather than as a clear refusal.
Not every backbone takes img_size -- a plain CNN is resolution-free and rejects the keyword.
That is a legitimate arch, not a mistake, so it is built without the keyword rather than refused.
(This is what lets the smoke suite exercise the whole path on a tiny CPU backbone.)

## Decision rules — fixed in advance, BEFORE any run

T107's rules are inherited verbatim and are not renegotiated here. Same architecture, same teacher, same held-out gold — this is T107's experiment on a lane that works, plus the recipe changes tabulated above.
- BROKEN → do not submit, debug: gold-58 < 0.85 at full fidelity.
The published arm reads 0.9128–0.9213.

- VOID, not a null: the run must show 58 gold excluded from training and present in validation, and the labels resolving to labels_ours.parquet — never llm_labels.csv, which scores gold 1.0000 because its is_gold rows carry gold values.
- A SHORT RUN CANNOT PRODUCE A NULL. Inherited from T107 and it binds here too.

- Then the LB adjudicates, ONE submission, our arm swapped for theirs inside the CoAtNet stage at the same weight, everything else byte-identical. ±0.007 against S = 0.941: ≥ 0.948 ADOPT · ≤ 0.934 REJECT · between UNRESOLVED and recorded. Every other cell byte-identical, asserted by digest rather than by reading.
The guard must kill a hung fold, and must not kill a working one.
A watchdog that fires on a healthy run is worse than none: it would end every fold twenty minutes in, because train.py prints once an epoch and an epoch is half an hour.
So the stall test is an AND -- no log growth AND zero GPU utilization -- and both halves are exercised here against a fake nvidia-smi on PATH, so no check in this file touches the real card.
The kill path also has to produce the thing neither T004 nor T007 could produce: a Python stack.

ptrace_scope=1 and no sudo means no py-spy, so the only way in is a signal the process handles itself, and the only handler that works while the main thread spins inside a C call is faulthandler's, which runs without the GIL.
pragma: no cover
Utilization always reads 0, so the log-growth half of the AND is the only thing separating the two runs below.
That is the point.
The path must end in src/train.py: the watchdog decides what it is allowed to kill by reading /proc/<pid>/cmdline, never by pgrep.
Two independent refusals.
The pid check is what stops a stalled anything-else from being killed;
the compute-app count is what stops the watchdog guessing which process to watch.

THE SAME GUARD src/metric.py:27 AND scripts/label_gaps.py:87 USE, and this was the only one of the three without it. sklearn does not RAISE on a single-class column -- it warns and returns NaN.

NaN then defeats this script's own refusal, because max(|nan - logged|) is NaN and if nan > 0.001 is False: the "REFUSING to plot: this is not the instrument PROGRESS.md logged" gate passes, and a figure with a nan panel is drawn and read as evidence.
A guard that a NaN walks straight through is the defect class this project logs as "a check that passes for a reason its label does not describe".
